description: Get a structured brief for a category: market overview, considering factors, gotchas, common questions, needs, and keywords. Pass exactly one of: category_id (a top-level category slug from list_categories, e.g. "pet-supplies") to aggregate all sub-categories under it, or subcategory_id (a numeric node id from list_categories) to get a single node's own brief. Omitting both returns an error.
name: get_sub_category_brief
